title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Lifecycle and Batch Limits
content:
A batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches moves from accepted to shopping, then to delivering (for batch types in which the shopper delivers) and to completed; a Shop-Only Batch goes straight from shopping to completed. Every status change is recorded by the system from the shopper's app, and the agent never advances a batch's status.

## Statuses

| Status | What it means |
|---|---|
| Accepted | The shopper has accepted the offer and the batch record is open. |
| Shopping | Shopping of the batch has begun. |
| Delivering | The shopper has checked out and left the store with the orders. |
| Completed | The last order has been handed over, staged or returned to the store. |
| Dropped | The shopper gave up the batch and it is reassigned. |
| Canceled | Every order in the batch was canceled by its customer. |
| Finalized | The batch's pay and tips have become final. |

## Standing limits

- A batch carries at most the batch type's orders per batch, its maximum item units and an estimated route of at most its maximum route miles.
- Alcohol is handed over only after the in-app ID scan where the batch type requires it.
- Weekly payouts sweep earnings up to the weekly earnings cut-off.
- An offer not accepted within the batch type's offer window passes to another shopper and creates no batch.
- Each posted pay component is shown to the shopper where the batch type shows the pay breakdown.

## Points of judgement

- A Shop-Only Batch never shows the delivering status.
- A batch whose status in the record has not moved cannot be moved by the desk; status changes come only from the shopper's app through the system.
